decisions.reason: A black-finish variant of existing drainage products builds directly on the firm's metal finishing knowledge, but it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests a trend-driven finish that could be streamlined if demand is weak.
A shower channel for seamless coverings is a close extension of the firm's core drainage channel expertise and has a page of its own, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and refine it.

Pump-assisted drainage brings in electromechanical knowledge further from the firm's fabricated metal base, which makes early results harder to learn from, but it fills a renovation niche and only mentions so far do not yet justify withdrawal.
A tileable floor drain with grating is core stainless drainage know-how with a page of its own, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to improve it.
A stainless steel design grate draws directly on the firm's metalworking competence and has its own page, so it is well positioned for continued refinement.
